sections.heading: Why Choose an Above Ground Safe Room?
sections.html:
Above ground safe rooms offer distinct advantages, especially for those seeking immediate and accessible storm protection. Unlike underground shelters that require excavation and can be difficult to access for some individuals, above ground units are installed directly within your home or business. This makes them an excellent choice for elderly family members, individuals with mobility issues, or anyone who prefers not to navigate stairs during a storm.

These shelters provide a visible, secure refuge that can be reached quickly when every second counts. They integrate seamlessly into your existing space, often within a garage or an interior room, without altering your property's exterior. This convenience, combined with their superior protection, makes them a practical investment for life safety.

sections.heading: Our Above Ground Safe Room Features & Installation
sections.html:
Texoma Storm Shelters provides robust above ground safe rooms constructed from heavy-duty modular steel. These units are engineered to withstand extreme tornado forces, earning an EF5 rating for maximum protection. Our shelters are designed for secure installation, typically anchored to the concrete slab of your garage or an interior room.

Key features of our safe rooms include:

  • Modular Steel Panels: High-strength steel construction for ultimate durability.
  • Secure Anchoring: Professionally anchored to your concrete foundation for immovable stability.
  • Customizable Sizes: Available in various dimensions to fit your specific needs and space.
  • Easy Access Doors: Outward-swinging, reinforced doors that allow for easy entry and exit, even if debris is against the exterior.

Our licensed and insured team handles every aspect of the installation process, ensuring your safe room meets all structural requirements and local codes. We prioritize efficient and precise installation to provide you with a reliable sanctuary.

sections.heading: Understanding Safe Room Standards: FEMA P-320 & ICC-500
sections.html:
When investing in a storm shelter, understanding the industry standards is paramount. Our above ground safe rooms are meticulously designed and constructed to meet or exceed the stringent guidelines outlined in FEMA P-320 and ICC-500. These standards are critical for ensuring a shelter can truly protect occupants from the extreme forces of a tornado.

FEMA P-320, 'Taking Shelter from the Storm: Building a Safe Room for Your Home or Small Business,' provides guidance on safe room design and construction. The ICC-500, 'Standard for the Design and Construction of Storm Shelters,' is a nationally recognized standard that specifies minimum requirements for storm shelters. By adhering to these benchmarks, we guarantee that your Texoma Storm Shelters safe room offers certified, life-saving protection.

Choosing a shelter that is independently verified to meet these standards is vital. It means the materials, design, and construction methods have been rigorously tested and proven effective against tornado-force winds and impacts.

faq.q: What is an above ground safe room?
faq.a: An above ground safe room is a reinforced structure installed inside an existing building, such as a home or business, to provide protection from tornadoes and severe weather. Unlike underground shelters, it sits on the existing concrete slab and is designed for quick, accessible entry, especially beneficial for those with mobility concerns.

faq.q: How much do above ground safe rooms cost in Sherman TX?
faq.a: The cost for an above ground safe room in Sherman TX generally ranges from $4,500 to $9,500. This price includes the safe room unit and professional installation. The exact cost will depend on the size of the unit and any specific customization options you select. We offer free written estimates.

faq.q: Where can an above ground safe room be installed?
faq.a: Above ground safe rooms are versatile and can be installed in various interior locations within your home or business. Common installation sites include garages, closets, utility rooms, or even a corner of a living space. They are securely anchored to your existing concrete foundation.

faq.q: Are your safe rooms FEMA compliant?
faq.a: Yes, all our above ground safe rooms are designed and installed to meet or exceed the rigorous safety standards outlined in FEMA P-320 and ICC-500. These standards ensure that the shelters provide proven, life-saving protection against EF5 tornado forces and projectile impacts.
